definitions.explanation: An incorrect judgment or ruling, particularly in legal or sports contexts. Refers to a decision made by a judge, referee, or authority that turns out to be wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誤判|ごはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: A bad call by the referee changed the course of the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誤判|ごはん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{無実|むじつ}→無実：09504_mujitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有罪|ゆうざい}→有罪：13003_yuuzai⟧になった。
examples.english: An erroneous ruling by the court led to an innocent person being found guilty.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビデオ→ビデオ：01499_bideo⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、{誤判|ごはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}した→減少する：19026_genshousuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧なくなったわけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The introduction of video review has significantly reduced the number of wrong calls, but they have not been completely eliminated.

notes:
A compound of {誤|ご} (error/mistake) and {判|はん} (judgment/ruling). Used in both legal and sports contexts to describe an incorrect decision by an authority.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誤判|ごはん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: acknowledge a wrong ruling
- {誤判|ごはん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: wrong calls continue
- {誤判|ごはん}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: prevention of misjudgments

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誤審|ごしん}→誤審：19183_goshin⟧: misjudgment in refereeing (more specific to sports officiating)
- {誤判定|ごはんてい}: incorrect decision (slightly more formal)
- ⟦{冤罪|えんざい}→冤罪：08392_enzai⟧: false conviction; wrongful charge (the consequence of a legal misjudgment)

NOTE ON READING:
This word is a homophone of ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ (rice/meal). Context always makes the distinction clear, as {誤判|ごはん} appears in legal or sports contexts.
